{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = "/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv"
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Inspect the data
print("Shape:", df.shape)
print("Columns:", df.columns.tolist())
print("Data types:\n", df.dtypes)
print("First 5 rows:\n", df.head())

# Check for sentinel values in customer_age
print("\nValues of customer_age == -1:", (df['customer_age'] == -1).sum())

# Check for QA orders
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print("\nQA orders found:", len(qa_orders))

# Check for refunded orders
refunded = df[df['status'] == 'refunded']
print("\nRefunded orders found:", len(refunded))

# Show unique values in channel and customer_segment
print("\nUnique channels:", df['channel'].unique())
print("Unique customer_segments:", df['customer_segment'].unique())"}
